examples.source: Given finite real x and bounds a < b, return (x-a)/(b-a) clipped to [0,1]; the result is monotone in x.
examples.contract: Finite inputs; a < b; output in [0,1]; monotonicity; f(a,a,b)=0 and f(b,a,b)=1.
examples.validation: Boundary examples, finite triples, monotone pairs, translation metamorphism, dual-runtime comparison, and exact-rational SMT checking.
obligations: normalized output is clipped to the closed unit interval
normalization is monotone in x and maps both bounds exactly

examples.source: Password reset revokes sessions before success; bad credentials and lockout are publicly indistinguishable; credentials never appear in logs.
examples.contract: Reset success follows revocation in the trace; public failures are equal; emitted logs satisfy credential secrecy.
examples.validation: Model-based commands, ordering and secrecy trace checks, invalid-password metamorphism, and reset fault injection.
obligations: reset revokes prior sessions before success
bad credentials and lockout have equal public failure

examples.source: Features use no future observations; normalization is training-only; hyperparameters never use test data; test evaluation occurs exactly once.
examples.contract: Feature lineage is bounded by prediction time; scaler lineage is training-only; selection excludes test IDs; one test event follows frozen selection.
examples.validation: Future sentinels, future perturbation, test-label metamorphism, lineage inspection, and leakage mutants.
obligations: feature lineage does not exceed prediction time
test evaluation occurs exactly once after selection

examples.source: Transfer request IDs are idempotent, distinct IDs may denote distinct transfers, and crash-after-debit remains recoverable.
examples.contract: At most one debit per request ID and payload; changed-payload reuse is rejected; crash replay converges observationally.
examples.validation: Retry, reorder, duplicate, and named-crash state machines; duplicate-message metamorphism; bounded model checking; dual-runtime fault injection.
obligations: one request id commits at most one debit
id reuse with changed payload is rejected

examples.source: Support staff may export retained audit events only when authorized by the current policy.
examples.contract: No export occurs without an authorization decision; policy, retention, staff identity, authorization source, and fields remain unresolved.
examples.validation: Validate authorization gating mechanics only; block compilation and strong verdicts until typed holes are resolved and approved.
obligations: no export occurs without an authorization decision

threshold.survivor_policy: every survivor requires an explicit non-semantic rationale
